question_text: A police officer receives a tip that a suspected drug dealer is hiding illegal drugs in his house. Without a warrant, the officer forces open the door and searches the house, finding drugs. The suspect is charged. Under Article III of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is the most likely outcome?

options.text: The evidence is admissible because the tip provided probable cause.
The evidence is admissible because the search was incidental to a lawful arrest.
The evidence is inadmissible because the search was conducted without a warrant and no exception applies.
The evidence is admissible because the suspect consented to the search by not objecting.
